description:
I’m Kunal, and I work closely with students during the engineering admission journey in Maharashtra.
I help them break down CAP rounds, understand cutoff trends, and shortlist colleges and branches realistically.
My support during option filling focuses on avoiding common errors and improving chances of allotment.
I believe in clear explanations, honest advice, and steady guidance throughout the process.
My goal is to help students move forward with confidence and clarity.
